description: Source code for YAML configuration writer for RU OFH (Radio Unit Open Fronthaul) in a wireless communication system, including functions to build YAML nodes from configuration structs and to fill YAML schema.

methods.name: fill_ru_ofh_log_section
methods.description: Fills YAML node with log configuration details.

methods.name: fill_ru_ofh_expert_execution_section
methods.description: Fills YAML node with expert execution configuration details.

methods.name: fill_ru_ofh_hal_section
methods.description: Fills YAML node with HAL (Hardware Abstraction Layer) configuration if available.

methods.name: build_ru_ofh_cell_section
methods.description: Constructs a YAML node representing a cell configuration.

methods.name: fill_ru_ofh_section
methods.description: Fills YAML node with overall RU OFH configuration including GPS and cells.

methods.name: fill_ru_ofh_metrics_section
methods.description: Fills YAML node with metrics configuration.

methods.name: fill_ru_ofh_config_in_yaml_schema
methods.description: Main function to fill YAML schema with complete RU OFH configuration.
